integrity.mathematical_claim: All-weight spectral-gap formula proved by explicit primal and Euclidean dual certificates; exact symbolic and finite-matrix checks passed.
integrity.unproved_limits: No claim beyond the stated family and objective.

scientific_limitations: Graph family is the triangular book with at least two pages and exactly one pendant leaf at a chosen hub.
Uniform total edge-conductance budget only; nonnegative weights allowed. No one-page case or distinct edge costs.
All-optima claim concerns mandatory deletion of only the hub spine when the page count is at least five; other weights are not asserted unique.
Earlier specialized graph-optimization literature could overlap; one plausible 1993 article was only accessible at the abstract level.
title: A five-page spine-deletion threshold for fastest diffusion on pendant book graphs
